Babu informs the Gokuldham families that their homes will not be getting a renovation as he cannot find enough workers.
The Gokuldham society members are happy that their home renovations are finally done, but someone shows up to stop their celebration.

Champaklal informs Daya about a recent jewellery theft near Gokuldham. Their own safety is threatened when a thief breaks into Jethalal's house and points a gun at them.
When everyone leaves for work early in the morning, Bhide struggles to start his scooter. Sodhi arrives and asks for a lift on Sakharam to his garage.
Two con artists, Vicky and Mona, come up with a plan to rob Gokuldham Society. Mona knocks on every door, introducing herself as Daya's friend.
Vicky and Mona's scheme to rob Gokuldham Society unfolds flawlessly. Mona infiltrates Jethalal's home, targeting Daya's valuables.
When Vicky and Mona reach a critical point in their Gokuldham Society heist, Popatlal unexpectedly spots them in the compound.
Vicky and Mona successfully carry out their plan to rob Gokuldham Society, managing to escape with the stolen jewellery.
Everyone in Gokuldham faces a harrowing ordeal as thieves make off with valuables in broad daylight.
Abdul apprehends the jewellery thieves as they attempt to flee and returns them to Gokuldham. The police arrive to make arrests, but Inspector Pandey appears disgruntled.
Jethalal learns about the robbery and praises Inspector Pandey for catching the robbers. Bhide and Popatlal receive gifts from a mysterious benefactor.
